parameters.name: DbInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB cluster.

parameters.name: DbNodeIds
parameters.description: The list of nodes in the target PolarDB cluster. Nodes from different clusters are separated by commas (,), and nodes within the same cluster are separated by colons (:).

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

parameters.name: Weights
parameters.description: The weights corresponding to PolarDB groups. Separate multiple weights with commas (,).
